Compare live NCCS filers with the local archive

Source: R/source-nccs.R
npc_compare_sources.Rd

Reads the same tax years from the SOI panel archive and from a live NCCS build and reports how far they agree: organization counts and resource totals by year, counts by market, and an EIN-level match of financial values and county. Imputed gap-year rows are left out of the archive side, since live builds have none.

Usage

npc_compare_sources(
  years,
  archive_dir = npc_archive_dir(),
  nccs_dir = npc_cache_dir(),
  geo = c("county", "cbsa"),
  resources = c("TOTREV", "TOTEXP", "NETASS", "TOTASS"),
  subsection = 3
)

Arguments

years

Tax years present in both sources.

archive_dir

Archive directory; see npc_archive_dir().

nccs_dir

Live build directory; see npc_cache_dir(). Missing years are built.

geo

Market level for the by-market comparison: "county" or "cbsa".

resources

Resource columns to compare.

subsection

501(c) subsections to keep, or NULL for all.

Value

A list of data frames:

totals

By year and source: rows, distinct organizations and resource totals

ein_match

By year: EINs in both sources or only one, extra archive rows for an EIN already seen that year, and among EINs in both, the share with the same filer type, county, and each resource within $1

markets

By market and year: organizations in each source, the difference and the ratio

market_summary

By year: correlation of market counts and the median absolute percent difference, for markets with 10 or more archive organizations

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
cmp <- npc_compare_sources( 2017:2019 )
cmp$totals
cmp$ein_match
} # }
